html:
G'oya

Kechikish ikki sana orasidagi kunlar soni: delivered_date dan promised_date ni ayiramiz. Shu son 2 dan katta bo'lgan qatorlar qoladi. Hali yetkazilmagan buyurtmada ayirma NULL bo'ladi, NULL > 2 esa rost emas, shuning uchun ular alohida shartsiz o'zi tushib qoladi.

Yechim

PostgreSQL'da ikki DATE ning ayirmasi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kunlar soni, butun son:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id, customer, delivered_date - promised_date AS delay_days
FROM deliveries
WHERE delivered_date - promised_date > 2
ORDER BY delay_days DESC, id

SQLite'da sana oddiy matn, uni ayirib bo'lmaydi. julianday sanani kunlar hisobidagi songa aylantiradi, ikki julianday ning ayirmasi kunlar soni bo'ladi:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT id, customer,
       CAST(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(promised_date) AS INTEGER) AS delay_days
FROM deliveries
WHERE julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(promised_date) > 2
ORDER BY delay_days DESC, id

julianday kasr son qaytaradi (3.0), CAST uni butun songa aylantiradi.

Tuzoqlar

"2 kundan ko'p" degani > 2. Namunada Aziz aynan 2 kun kutgan va u natijaga kirmaydi, >= 2 esa uni ham qo'shadi.

SQLite'da delivered_date - promised_date xato bermaydi, lekin noto'g'ri ishlaydi. Matnni songa aylantirganda SQLite faqat boshidagi raqamlarni oladi: '2024-05-13' dan 2024. Natijada ayirma deyarli doim 0 bo'ladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, customer, delivered_date - promised_date AS delay_days
FROM deliveries
WHERE delivered_date - promised_date > 2
ORDER BY delay_days DESC, id

Oy kunlarini ayirish (13 - 10) faqat bitta oy ichida ishlaydi. Namunadagi Bekzodning buyurtmasi 28-mayga va'da qilingan, 3-iyunda kelgan: kunlar ayirmasi 3 - 28, aslida esa 6 kun. Shu sababli PostgreSQL'dagi AGE ham bu yerga to'g'ri kelmaydi: 35 kunlik kechikish uchun u 1 mon 4 days qaytaradi, undan olingan kun 4 bo'ladi.

Dialektlar farqi

Shartni ayirmasiz ham yozish mumkin: sanaga 2 kun qo'shib, yetkazish sanasi bilan solishtiramiz. PostgreSQL'da DATE ga butun son qo'shiladi, SQLite'da date funksiyasi va '+2 days' qo'llaniladi:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT id, customer, delivered_date - promised_date AS delay_days
FROM deliveries
WHERE delivered_date > promised_date + 2
ORDER BY delay_days DESC, id
Faqat SQLiteSELECT id, customer,
       CAST(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(promised_date) AS INTEGER) AS delay_days
FROM deliveries
WHERE delivered_date > date(promised_date, '+2 days')
ORDER BY delay_days DESC, id
